spans.s: māppaṇam (SITI), Tamil; same as Sanskrit mahā-paṇa; name of a coin.
māppaṇam (SITI), Tamil; a tax payable at the rate of one paṇam for every mā.
māppaṇam , same as Sanskrit mahāpaṇa; may be also ‘tax of one paṇa per mā measure of grains’.
māppadakku (SITI), Tamil; payment at the rate of one padakku or two kuruṇi for every mā.
māppaṭṭaḍai (SITI), Tamil; tax probably for the penning of cattle; may also be mara-ppaṭṭaḍai, ‘a timber depot’; tax payable for the same.
